DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica caused by an acute lumbar herniated disc.

The clinical picture of sudden back pain radiating to the foot during exercise is classic for a disc herniation compressing the nerve root. I will now ask a few final questions to confirm neurological involvement and rule out cauda equina syndrome before finalizing the plan. Do you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot?
